title: Substring with Concatenation of All Words
statement_short: Given a string s and an array of strings words of equal length, find all starting indices of substrings in s that are a concatenation of each word in words exactly once.
hint: Fixed word length allows running k sliding windows of step size k to check word frequency matches.
why_not: Right: Sliding Window over word-length steps tracks word frequency matches in O(n \* k) time using a frequency map. Not Trie: Prefix trees store string dictionaries, but do not handle multi-word sliding frequency counts efficiently. Not HashMap / Hash Set: Checking every substring independently with hash maps takes O(n \* m \* k) time without sliding window reuse. Not Backtracking: Permutating all words recursively causes TLE due to exponential search space.
complexity: O(n \* k) time, O(m \* k) space
